summary: A pull request run now looks for the evidence note of the pull request head tree, not of GitHub's merge ref, under strict conditions and with a fall back to the merge tree; nothing is enforced

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; this changes the CI evidence gate, its workflow environment and tests only.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes. Every check stays enforce false, so no job is skipped because of this change; the decision line gains tree_of, pr_head, merge_tree and head_tree fields.

compatibility.detail: No command, frame, scope or stored-format change in the product.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator action is required by this change.

recovery.detail: No persistent product state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
